# amiga-news.de — Linux PowerPC availability report

- Original source: [Linux: PowerPC port of Robin Hood](https://www.amiga-news.de/en/news/AN-2006-07-00103-EN.html)
- Author / publication: snx; translation cad; amiga-news.de, citing Pegasos.org.
- Language / date: English translation; 2006-07-30.
- Access: Indexed news item inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The report credits Gunnar von Boehn’s assistance with making the game available on Linux PowerPC. It says existing Linux/x86 retail CDs can supply the installation, with a separate roughly 3 MB PowerPC update needed to run it. A demo is linked, and publication of the update on RuneSoft’s site is expected shortly.

This is a concrete historical lead for the relationship between the x86 disc and PowerPC executable. Linked downloads were not inspected, so the report does not independently establish their contents or continued availability.
